speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Squamous Cell Carcinoma (SCC) of the penis and finger.

The combination of a non-healing, red, crusty lesion on the penis and a similar lesion on the finger, along with your history of heavy smoking and lack of response to previous treatments for syphilis or eczema, is highly suspicious for malignancy. Given your age, smoking history, and the specific nature of these lesions, we need to confirm this immediately. REQUEST TEST: Biopsy of penile lesion and digital lesion; CBC, BMP, and HbA1c.
